findings.finding: Netcapital funds itself through frequent unregistered placements and convertible notes. 8-Ks carrying Item 3.02 were filed on 2026-05-01, 05-18, 05-28, 06-10 (twice), 06-16, 07-08, 07-09 and 08-10. With the 10-K and 10-Q delinquent and no usable shelf, another private placement or note can be announced on any evening, including tonight.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A placement under Section 4(a)(2) or Reg D needs no registration statement, so it can be signed and 8-K'd any evening. The cadence is about 9 such 8-Ks in roughly 100 sessions, which puts the chance of one landing tonight or tomorrow at around 10%. This is a probability over the window, not a dated event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Several of this name's comparable falls cluster around financing 8-Ks: 2026-08-11 -12.94% fell another -5.43% the next session, the day after the 2026-08-10 note-amendment 8-K. Causation is not established.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's 0.09x volume means no seller showed size, so the close prices a stock with no new supply. If a placement were expected, the fall would carry volume. Its absence is what a 3.02 8-K tonight would change.
findings.independence: The 2026-08-10 8-K shows Vanquish Funding convertible notes repriced to 65% of the lowest 20-day trading price, convertible on default. That is a lender that sells into strength. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1414767/000149315226036916/form8-k.htm
